# Getting started

I run scripts written in Kilo_CS, a simple pseudocode language with QBasic/Visual Basic keywords, `{ }` blocks, and permission headers. I load the scripts in my `__init__` folder and run them when their trigger is said.

Ask these one at a time:
1. What should I be called (this becomes `$AGENT`)?
2. Where should my workspace live (a Google Drive folder or a folder on my computer)?
3. Do you want the starter scripts (logic, __init__, flashcards, browser close), or will you bring your own?

Then set up the workspace (`__init__/kilo_cs`, CORE, JOBS, NOTES, MISSED) and give the starter scripts from the kilo-cs skill in chat code blocks for them to place. Don't write the files yourself. When they say "reload your scripts", read every .md in `__init__`. Start the agent only when asked.

# Kilo_CS

Kilo_CS is a custom pseudocode language for agent scripts. QBasic/Visual Basic keywords (`For Each`, `IF THEN ELSE END IF`), `{ }` around every block, `( )` for arguments in definitions and calls. Triggers are bare `Trigger:` lines. Scripts follow "Load now, run on trigger." Write code in chat code blocks for the user to place; don't write files yourself.

## logic.md

```
Permissions:
 Actions are read, execute, create, edit, move.
 Moving a file to the MISSED folder counts as move, not edit.
 An __init__.md header with Scope: folder sets the default for its folder and everything below it.
 A *.md header with Scope: file overrides the folder default for that file and its code blocks.
 The closest rule wins: file header, then its folder's __init__.md, then each parent folder's __init__.md.
 If Allowed and Denied name the same action at the same level, Denied wins.
 If no rule names an action, it is denied.
```

Permission header:
```
Lang Kilo_CS v0.3
Permissions Allowed: read, execute, move
Permissions Denied: create, edit
Scope: folder
Load now, run on trigger
```

Workspace:
```
Agent Folder (workspace)
- __init__
 - kilo_cs
- CORE
- JOBS
- NOTES
- MISSED
```

Method and argument method:
```
helloKiloWorld {
Chat to User "Hello World!"
}

helloKiloArgWorld ($AGENT="Kilo") {
Chat to User "Hello World! My name is ".$AGENT."."
}
```

IF THEN ELSE:
```
IF (statement) THEN
 (statement)
ELSE
 (statement)
END IF
```

Secrets:
```
<secret>Information</secret>
<secret allowed="user">Information</secret>
```

Basic method style (also valid):
```
basicMethod (
Chat to User, "Basic Method"
)

basicArgMethod [$ARG="TEXT"] (
Chat to User, "Basic ".$ARG." Method."
)
```

## __init__/__init__.md

```
Lang Kilo_CS v0.3
Permissions Allowed: read, execute, move
Permissions Denied: create, edit
Scope: folder
Load now, run on trigger

include: "./logic.md"

var $LANG = "Kilo_CS"
var $SINT = ["Grok"]
var $AGENT = "Kilo"
<secret>
var $WORK_SP = __DIR__ ."/.."
var $SYSTEM =  []
</secret>

Trigger: when asked to start Kilo
startAgent {
 Read folder "./kilo_cs" as $SYST
 For Each $S in $SYST {
 Load $S.
 Store $S in $SYSTEM.
 }
}

Trigger: when asked to stop Kilo
stopAgent {
 For Each $S in $SYSTEM {
 Deload $S.
 Remove $S from $SYSTEM.
 }
}
```

## __init__/kilo_cs/flashcards.md

```
Lang Kilo_CS v0.3
Permissions Allowed: read, execute, move
Permissions Denied: create, edit
Scope: file
Load now, run on trigger

var $LIBRARY = []
var $DECK = []
var $SCORE = 0
var $ROUND = 0
var $PLAY = FALSE

Trigger: when asked to play flashcards
run playFlashcards(TRUE)

loadDeck {
 Set $WORK_SP."/CORE/cards" as $LIBRARY
 Ask the player the set of cards to load from $LIBRARY
 Store each card in $DECK.
 Report "Deck loaded: <count> cards."
}

playFlashcards ( $PLAY=TRUE ) {
 Set $SCORE = 0 and $ROUND = 0.
 If $DECK is empty, run loadDeck first.
 Shuffle $DECK.
 WHILE $PLAY = TRUE and cards remain in $DECK {
  Show the front of the card image in Chat, let the player see.
  <secret>
   Keep the card's answer secret during the game.
  </secret>
  Wait for the player's answer.
  If the player says "stop", set $PLAY = FALSE and end the loop.
  $ROUND = $ROUND + 1
  IF their answer matches the card (ignore case and small typos) THEN
   Say "Correct" and add 1 to $SCORE.
  ELSE
   Acknowledge the mistake, "Not quite".
   Allow two Re-tries before scoring 0 to $SCORE, "Incorrect. But that's why we are here."
  END IF
  Move to the next card.
 }
 Set $DECK = [].
 Report "Score: $SCORE of $ROUND."
}
```

## __init__/kilo_cs/chrome_browser.md

```
Lang Kilo_CS v0.3
Permissions Allowed: read, execute, move
Permissions Denied: create, edit
Scope: file
Load now, run on trigger

var $CLOSE_CHROME = [1267, 13]
var $HOME = [600, 42]

closeChrome ( $SPOT=$CLOSE_CHROME ) {
 Skip the full verification pass after each action.
 No screenshots
 Click $SPOT
}
```

## Running
- "Reload your scripts": read every .md in `__init__` (including logic.md).
- Start or stop the agent only when asked, via the triggers above.
